statute.name: Ohio Public Records Act
statute.scope: All records kept by public offices; broad definition — any document created/received by public office
statute.exemptions: Law enforcement investigatory records, trial preparation records, medical records, adoption records, security records, infrastructure records
statute.response_deadline: Reasonable period — no fixed statutory deadline; courts have interpreted as prompt
statute.fee_structure: Actual cost of copies; no search fees; electronic records at cost of medium
statute.appeal_process: Ohio Court of Claims (expedited) or county Court of Common Pleas; attorney fees available for prevailing requestor

appeals_workflow: Submit written public records request to agency
If denied or delayed: file complaint with Ohio Court of Claims (expedited process) or county Court of Common Pleas
Court may award attorney fees and statutory damages for willful non-compliance
Ohio AG Public Records Mediation Program available as informal resolution

request_templates.standard: Dear Records Custodian: Pursuant to Ohio Public Records Act (ORC §149.43), I request copies of [describe records]. I request these records in electronic format if available. Please provide within a reasonable time. No identification or reason for request is required under Ohio law.
request_templates.expedited: Dear Records Custodian: Pursuant to ORC §149.43, I request immediate access to [describe records]. This request concerns [urgent matter]. Ohio law requires prompt response. If any records are withheld, please cite the specific statutory exemption.
